title: please include HTTP "Date:" header in xDrip Web Service responses
body:
1. It's required by the HTTP spec.
2. It's a useful way for a rig to get the phone's time.

Please consider supporting the HTTP HEAD method too, which would be useful when just the time is desired, and the actual BG entries aren't needed.

comments.body:
Has this been addressed?  
Can we close this issue?
Yes, it works fine now, at least in the old 2020.11.27 version I'm running.
